wizard_unknown_lead: lemonfiber did not say whether this machine is set up.
wizard_welcome_prose: lemonfiber asks a few questions, shows you everything it will write, and writes nothing until you say yes. Answers are kept on this machine, so you can stop and come back.
wizard_preflight_prose: lemonfiber checks this machine: the system, Docker, Compose and whether the Docker daemon answers.
wizard_prerequisites_prose: The accounts the download services you chose need: an indexer for either, a Usenet provider for Usenet, and a tunnel service for torrents. With neither chosen you need no accounts to serve the media you already have.
wizard_protocols_prose: Which download services do you have accounts for? Choose neither to serve the media you already have; you can add one later.
wizard_vpn_prose: Torrents show your home address to everyone you share with. A tunnel service carries them through an address of its own, which hides yours.
wizard_vpn_confirm: Everyone I share with will see my home address.
wizard_data_prose: Where downloads and the library are kept. Both live under this one folder, so a finished download can move into the library without being copied.
wizard_data_hint: A full path on this machine, such as /srv/media.
wizard_credentials_prose: The indexer that searches for releases. lemonfiber tries the key as soon as you give it.
wizard_provider_prose: Your Usenet provider. lemonfiber signs in once to check it.
wizard_provider_plain: Without encryption, your provider login and everything you download cross the internet where anyone along the way can read them. Leave it on unless your provider offers nothing else.
wizard_user_prose: The user and group the services run as. Files they write will belong to this user.
wizard_library_prose: Whether lemonfiber runs Jellyfin to play your library.
wizard_library_host_prose: Jellyfin on host is for a hardware encoder Docker cannot reach. Where it gains nothing on this machine, lemonfiber says so.
wizard_household_prose: Will other people at home use it? lemonfiber then gives each of them their own account.
wizard_autostart_prose: Whether the stack starts when this machine does.
wizard_review_prose: Everything below is what lemonfiber will write. Nothing is written until you say yes.
wizard_proof_unreachable: Nothing answered, so it is unproven: {detail}.
wizard_proof_other: What checking it came to is something this page has no words for.
wizard_recovery_prose: lemonfiber was writing your setup when it stopped. This is what it had written:
wizard_written_unknown: lemonfiber cannot tell what it had written.
wizard_resume_prose: Keep what was written and finish.
wizard_roll_back_prose: Undo what was written and go back to review.
wizard_start_over_prose: Undo what was written and forget every answer.
wizard_start_over_confirm: Starting over undoes what was written and forgets every answer you gave. You will begin again at the first question.
wizard_written_prose: Your setup is written. Start the stack to download images and run the services, then lemonfiber connects them to each other.
